hero.title: Reliable Metal Packaging Solutions for Food Industry
hero.description: We provide high-quality metal packaging solutions that meet food safety and durability standards, suitable for the food and beverage industry.

about.subtitle: ABOUT US
about.title: DELTA SEIKAN OVERVIEW
about.desc1: Founded in 2020, Delta Seikan Corporation is proud to be a pioneer in the field of metal packaging production in Vietnam, serving a variety of needs in the food and beverage industry.
about.desc2: With the philosophy of "Customer centered", we constantly improve technology and processes to bring top quality products, contributing to enhancing brand value for partners.

features.visionDesc: To become the leading manufacturer of metal packaging for the food industry in Vietnam.
features.missionDesc: Providing reliable and sustainable solutions to improve quality and service.

capability.title: Production Capability
capability.r1Desc: Conducting research, development and product testing to meet market needs, improving product quality and efficiency.
capability.r2Desc: Providing products with the best quality to customers with optimal production and management systems.
capability.r3Desc: We always commit that all products are tested to meet the signed quality standards and comply with the FSSC22000 food safety management system before delivery to customers.
capability.r4Desc: Regarding sales activities, we always try to understand customer needs and develop new markets, providing feedback to the R&D team to catch up with market trends to create products of the best quality at competitive prices.

timeline.title: Development Journey
timeline.y2020Desc: Officially went into operation with the vision of leading the metal packaging industry.
timeline.y2021Desc: Successfully implemented high-tech DRD can production line.
timeline.y2022Desc: Upgrading production capacity and modern warehouse.
timeline.y2023Desc: Achieved international food safety system certification.
